prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Miami for hurricane-rated roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t name one single “best” company for everyone — the best choice depends on your roof type, exact location, insurer requirements and budget — but I can help you find the best option for your situation. Before I narrow candidates down, a few quick questions and some guidance.

Quick questions
- Is this a residential or commercial roof?
- What Miami ZIP code or neighborhood?
- Roof type (asphalt shingle, tile, metal, flat/built-up)?
- Are you filing an insurance claim or paying cash?

What to require from any Miami contractor doing hurricane‑rated replacements
- Proper licensing and insurance: verify Florida contractor license and current general liability and workers’ comp. Ask for numbers and confirm online.
- Miami‑Dade/Florida approvals: materials that meet Miami‑Dade County Product Control or Florida Building Code wind and missile impact requirements (NOA or equivalent).
- Manufacturer certification: GAF Master Elite, CertainTeed SELECT ShingleMaster, Owens Corning Platinum Preferred, etc. (these require contractor vetting).
- Written warranties for both materials and workmanship (get duration and transferability in writing).
- Experience with hurricane straps, uplift systems and wind mitigation requirements for your roof type.
- Local references and recent projects in Miami—ask for at least 3.
- Good reviews & complaint history: check Google, Yelp, BBB, and Florida DBPR complaints.
- Written, itemized proposal showing permitting, tear‑off vs recover, deck repair, ventilation, flashings, and wind‑rated attachments.

If you want, I will:
- Find and vet top 3–5 Miami roofing contractors that meet the criteria above for your ZIP and roof type (including license/insurance, manufacturer certifications, Miami‑Dade approvals, recent reviews and sample estimates).
Tell me the ZIP code and roof type and I’ll pull a tailored list with links and the items above verified.
